description: Evaluates whether an agent, MCP server, or x402 endpoint satisfies deterministic Know Your Agent (KYA) security rules against addrbook's evidence ledger, returning allow, warn, or block with cited rule codes and evidence watermark.

block_contradicted.description: Block listings with copycat or contradictory evidence.

block_unlisted_pay_to.description: Block x402 payTo wallets absent from the agent's listing.

query.description: Agent slug, endpoint URL, host, 0x wallet, or registry ID.

require_clean_scan.description: Block high-severity MCP prompt-injection or invisible-char findings.

require_proven_owner.description: Require DNS TXT, .well-known, or MCP namespace ownership proof.

name: check_agent_policy
title: Run a KYA Policy Gate check
